author: (H.L. Clark, 1900)

note.en: A tiny brittle star of reef rubble, known here from museum collections. Disc size is an approximate field-guide value.
note.es: Una ofiura diminuta del escombro de arrecife, conocida aquí por colecciones de museo. El tamaño del disco es un valor aproximado de guías de campo.

evidence: GBIF: 18 records in the region (many are museum specimens)

sources.t: WoRMS: World Register of Marine Species, accepted name and range

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 18 records in the region (many are museum specimens).

marks.en: Small brittle star with a small disc and slim, banded arms, hiding in reef rubble.
marks.es: Ofiura pequeña de disco chico y brazos delgados anillados, escondida en cascajo arrecifal.
